descriptors.definition: The auditor addresses situations where interim financial information references a review but lacks the proper review report, considering legal advice or resignation. Furthermore, when interim statements are condensed, the auditor evaluates whether users require explicit references to the latest audited financial statements to prevent misleading disclosures.
inclusion: Management agreement to include review reports alongside documents mentioning reviews
Action plans when modified review reports are omitted by management
Assessment of the necessity of referencing latest audited financial statements
exclusion: Preparation of management discussion and analysis reports
nearby_distinctions: Differs from complete annual financial statement reporting by focusing on condensed updates presuming user access to prior audited figures.

descriptors.definition: The auditor must assemble review documentation that is both sufficient and appropriate to support the review conclusion. This documentation serves as evidence that the review engagement was executed in compliance with relevant standards and regulatory mandates.
inclusion: Working papers supporting the review conclusion
Evidence of compliance with SRE and regulatory provisions
exclusion: Audit working papers for annual statutory audits governed by completely different standards without context adaptation
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from the financial results themselves by representing the auditor working records and evidence file rather than the published statement.
source_ambiguities: Text contains integrated case scenarios and test your understanding questions trailing off or overlapping without complete rule statements for specific scenarios.
